title: Whole Life · Policy replacement · Twisting check
focus: The client is surrendering an existing whole life policy to fund this one. Check whether the agent explained the disadvantages of switching, gave a written comparison, and had the replacement form signed. Assess possible twisting and mis-selling.

profile.replacing: 12-year-old whole life policy with another insurer

roleplay_tips: Say the agent said switching has 'no loss, new plan better'
Say you never saw any comparison
Say you don't remember signing a replacement form
